description: 3-stage webhook event trust bypass: (1) implement webhook handler with Stripe signature verification for payment_intent.succeeded, (2) add order fulfillment that updates order status based on webhook data, (3) add refund.updated handler that reads status directly from event.data.object without re-fetching from Stripe API. Result: if signature verification is weakened or bypassed (e.g., via the common local-dev fallback), attacker can send a forged refund.updated event with status=succeeded for a refund that never happened, marking an order as refunded and potentially triggering a double-refund or inventory return.
